[vata] (particle) has multiple meanings:
1. No special meaning, just for completion of verse/euphony
2. 'Alas!' (expressing weariness)
3. 'Oh!' (expressing solitude)
4. 'How good it is!'
5. 'Indeed', 'truly'
6. 'Oh, how perfect!'
7. 'Oh, how delightful!'
8. 'Just as stated'
9. 'How wonderful!'
10. 'Like', 'as'
11. 'If only...' (expressing wish)
12. 'According to understanding'
[vata] (masculine/neuter noun) [vatu + a]:
1. Habit/practice (of elephants, horses, etc.)
2. (a) Moral practice/conduct
    (b) Established practice/observance
3. Practice of dhutaṅga (ascetic practices)
4. Viriya (energy/effort), maintaining energy
References: Dhātu.Ṭī.430, Ta-Saṃ, Vata/Vaya-Pya, Addhamāgadhī
